div.head: X Atr Prol. 3
div.ab: ⁊ þis is seo gerædnes, þe we willað healdan, swa swa we æt Eanham fæste gecwædon.
⁊ þis is seo gerædnes þe we willað healdan, swa swa we æt Eanham fæste gecwædon.
Pr.3 And þis is seo gerædnes þe we willað healdan, swa swa we æt Eanham fæste gecwædon.
Und Folgendes ist der Beschluss, den wir halten wollen, so wie wir zu Enham fest bestimmt haben.
And the following is the ordinance which we will keep, as we firmly decided at Enham.
And this is the ordinance which we desire to observe in accordance with what we have firmly decreed at Enham.
Pr.3 And this is the decree that we wish to observe, just as we firmly established at Enham.
div.note: Vr has a cross-reference sign here; four lines in the margin in another hand, each mutilated by four or five letters at the front (‘Godes gife … [Ea]dgares cinges ge … im þe ic Æðel[red] … ealle witan’), were meant to replace the underlined ‘þe wo’; the corrector seems to ascribe the content to Edgar (compare D of I Cn 1). Liebermann compares the Paraphrase of VI Atr, Prol.
[Pr.3] Enham: The site of the 1008 meeting at which 5 Æthelred and 6 Æthelred were promulgated.

note.seg: Folgt Heranziehungszeichen; hierzu gehören wohl am Rande von anderer Hand vier vorn durch Abreissen um je vier bis fünf Buchstaben verstümmelte Zeilen: Godes gife . . . . [Ea]dgares cinges ge . . . . im þe ic Æðel[red] . . . . ealle witan Diese Worte sollen ersetzen þe wo, das unterstrichen ist. Der Emendator scheint Eadgar den Ursprung des Inhaltes beizulegen. Vgl. Hs. D von I Cnut 1.

Followed by a reference mark; to this probably belong four lines in the margin in another hand, each mutilated at the beginning by four to five letters through tearing: Godes gife . . . . [Ea]dgares cinges ge . . . . im þe ic Æðel[red] . . . . ealle witan These words are meant to replace þe wo, which is underlined. The emender seems to ascribe the origin of the contents to Eadgar. Cf. MS D of I Cnut 1.
Dies bedeutet nicht: X Atr erging zu Enham, sondern: der Enhamer Beschluss wird im folgenden zitiert. Vgl. VI As 10¹¹
This does not mean that X Atr was issued at Enham, but that the Enham decree is quoted in what follows. Cf. VI As 10¹¹
Cf. VI Atr. Pre. and note.
